modules.excerpt:
class CrosswalkService:
    def __init__(self, db: Db, bus: SqliteBus | KafkaBus, crosswalk: SqliteCrosswalk, group: str = GROUP,
                 resolver: RulesResolver | None = None):
        self.db, self.bus, self.xw, self.group = db, bus, crosswalk, group
        self.resolver = resolver or RulesResolver(crosswalk)
        db.script(SCHEMA)
        outbox.ensure_schema(db)
        self.relay = Relay(db, bus)

    # --- enrichment -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _enrich(self, ev: CloudEvent, canonical: str, entity: str) -> CloudEvent:
        data = dict(ev.data)
        if entity == "vehicle":
            ids = self.xw.all_ids(ev.agencyid, canonical, at=ev.time)   # G3 (A148): the rows valid at the event
            data["refs"] = VehicleRefs(
                canonical=canonical, telematics=ids.get("telematics"),
                maintenance=ids.get("maintenance"), scheduling=ids.get("scheduling")).model_dump()
        else:
            data["operator_canonical"] = canonical
        return ev.model_copy(update={"data": data, "canonicalid": canonical})

    def _identify(self, ev: CloudEvent, product: str, native: str,
                  entity: str) -> tuple[str | None, Resolution | None, list[str]]:
        """(canonical or None, resolution, notes). Fast path: exactly one canonical id mapped to this native id
        valid at the event's own time. Otherwise vehicle events go to the resolver; operators stay exact-only."""
        rows = self.xw.candidates(ev.agencyid, product, native, at=ev.time)
        canon = sorted({r.canonical_id for r in rows})
        d = ev.data
        evidence = Evidence(native_id=native, vin=d.get("native_vin"), plate=d.get("native_plate"),
                            name=d.get("native_name"))
        if len(canon) == 1:
            check = getattr(self.resolver, "contradiction", None)
            if entity == "vehicle" and check is not None and \
                    (res := check(ev.agencyid, product, evidence, ev.time, canon[0])) is not None:
                return None, res, ["the event's VIN or plate names a different vehicle than its id (F1)"]
            conflicts = getattr(self.resolver, "conflict_notes", None)   # G2 (A149): resolves, conflict recorded

class System:
    def __init__(self, agency: str, mocks: Mocks, data_dir: str | Path | None = None, *,
                 reasoner: Reasoner | None = None, seed_crosswalk: bool = True, bus: str | None = None,
                 db: str | None = None):
        self.agency, self.mocks, self.clock = agency, mocks, mocks.clock
        self.dir = Path(data_dir or tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="transitos-"))
        # we made it, we own it: removed on close(), when collected, or at exit (never a caller's directory)
        self._owned_dir_cleanup = weakref.finalize(self, shutil.rmtree, str(self.dir), True) if data_dir is None else None
        self.dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self.bus_kind = bus_kind(bus)
        self.db_kind = db_kind(db)
        self.config_dir = INTEGRATION_CONFIG if (INTEGRATION_CONFIG / f"{agency}.yaml").exists() else TOOLS_CONFIG_DIR
        self.reasoner = reasoner or reasoner_from_env()   # stub unless TRANSITOS_REASONER=anthropic
        self.policy_patch: dict[str, Any] = {}   # scenario overrides (e.g. vehicle_fit), merged into policy()
        # Phase 10 Step 4: registry settings overrides per agency (local_time, timezone, maintenance.mode), read live
        self.registry_settings: dict[str, dict] = {agency: {}}
        self.seq = Seq()
        self.writes = WriteLog(self.seq, lambda: [r["run_id"] for r in self.store.list_runs()])
        self.on_resolved: Callable[[CloudEvent, HandleResult], None] | None = None  # narration hook
        # ordered operations log: human decisions, approval expiries, kill-switch toggles (shares `seq`

class OpenAIReasoner:
    name = MODEL
    prompt_version = "openai-demo-v1"

    def __init__(self, *, key: str | None = None, client: httpx.Client | None = None,
                 budget: DemoBudget | None = None):
        self._key = key
        self._client = client
        self.budget = budget or DemoBudget()

    def propose(self, facts: dict, attempt: int = 0) -> dict:
        payload = {"model": MODEL, "instructions": SYSTEM + (
            " Prior incidents are historical context only, never current availability, policy or permission. "
            "Choose only from today's supplied feasible options; every new run needs its own approval."), "input": build_prompt(facts),
                   "max_output_tokens": MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS, "store": False,
                   "text": {"format": {"type": "json_schema", "name": "dispatcher_proposal",
                                       "strict": True, "schema": SCHEMA}}}
        # UTF-8 bytes bound tokenized text conservatively; extra room for schema/framing.
        input_bound = len(json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False).encode()) + 4096
        if input_bound > 24000:
            raise OpenAIUnavailable("Proposal context exceeds the demo request bound")
        token = self.budget.reserve(input_bound * INPUT_PRICE + MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS * OUTPUT_PRICE)
        own_client = self._client is None
        client = self._client or httpx.Client(timeout=20.0, follow_redirects=False)
        try:
            response = client.post("https://api.openai.com/v1/responses", json=payload,
                                   headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {self._key}", "Content-Type": "application/json"})
            if response.status_code != 200:
                # Never include the vendor response/body or a key-bearing request in an error.
                raise OpenAIUnavailable(f"OpenAI request failed (HTTP {response.status_code}); reserved cost retained")
            doc = response.json()
            usage = doc.get("usage") or {}
            it, ot = usage.get("input_tokens"), usage.get("output_tokens")
            if isinstance(it, int) and isinstance(ot, int) and it >= 0 and ot >= 0:
                self.budget.settle(token, it * INPUT_PRICE + ot * OUTPUT_PRICE)

class DemoSession:
    def __init__(self, reasoner: Reasoner | None = None, memory: IncidentMemory | None = None):
        self.memory = memory or IncidentMemory()
        self.reasoner = MemoryReasoner(reasoner or reasoner_from_env(), self.memory, AGENCY)
        self.lock = threading.RLock()
        self.worker = ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=1, thread_name_prefix="transitos-demo")
        self.busy = False
        self.error: str | None = None
        self.trace: list[dict] = []
        self.world = IntegrationWorld(reasoner=self.reasoner, bus="sqlite", db="sqlite")
        self.snapshot: dict = {}
        self.reset()

    @property
    def system(self):
        return self.world.system

    def reset(self):
        self.generation = uuid.uuid4().hex
        self.trace = []
        self.assessment = None
        self.notifications, self.notification_keys = [], set()
        self.product_baseline = None
        self.world.apply(BY_ID["operator_swap_needed"])

cases.title: Complete approved service-continuity loop
cases.evidence: Zero pre-approval writes; five forward actions with alert last; delayed alert visibility; separate return approval; DONE with clean invariants.

cases.title: Rejection has no product effect
cases.evidence: Rejected proposal creates no product effect and no success memory.

cases.title: Stale/reset approvals cannot act
cases.evidence: An approval from an earlier demo generation is refused before any write.

cases.title: Unknown safety evidence requires acknowledgement
cases.evidence: Unknown safety fields remain offered with explicit acknowledgement; silent approval is blocked.

cases.title: Invalid model IDs cannot reach products
cases.evidence: Invented vehicle/operator IDs are rejected; validated code fallback completes safely after approval. No live model used.

cases.title: Memory persists without widening authority
cases.evidence: Successful history survives reset and a new connection, is idempotent and agency-scoped, and grants no new write authority.

cases.title: Organisation ceiling cannot widen app spending
cases.evidence: A $120 configured ceiling is clamped to $0.50; exhausted budget sends no HTTP request.

cases.title: Kill switch prevents approved execution
cases.evidence: A paused agency refuses approval execution before a product write.
